#"'!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Retry the saved suite through the public API; never purchases credits."""
import argparse,json,time,sys
from api import call,ROOT
p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('"'--key',default='arithmetic-smoke-resume-20261115',help='Reuse for safe retries; change only for a deliberately new run')
a=p.parse_args()
body=json.loads((ROOT/'launch.json').read_text())
body['idempotencyKey']=a.key
r=call('/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs',body,label='launch-resumed')
if r['status']"'!=202:
 print('"'Launch refused; inspect launch-resumed.json. No purchase attempted.');sys.exit(2)
run=r['body']['runId'];base='/projects/project_fixture/eval-runs/'+run
(ROOT/'run-id.txt').write_text(run+'\\n')
end=time.monotonic()+90
while True:
 r=call(base,label='run-result')
 if r['status']"'!=200:sys.exit(2)
 status=r['"'body'].get('status')
 if status in ('completed','failed','cancelled','timed_out'):break
 if time.monotonic()>end:
  print('Poll timeout; run may still be active. Use saved run-id.txt to inspect it.');sys.exit(3)
 time.sleep(2)
call(base+'/iterations',label='iterations')
call(base+'/decision',label='decision')
sys.exit(0 if status=='completed' and r['body'].get('result') in ('passed','pass') else 1)

## Resume after the environment confirms repair

The existing MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY environment variables are used;
credentials are not stored in these files.

"'```sh
cd /workspace/mcpjam-eval
python3 resume.py
```

The default idempotency key deduplicates retries. For an intentionally new
repeat after a successful run, use `python3 resume.py --key <new-unique-key>`.
The script saves launch receipt, run ID, terminal result and iterations;
it polls at most 90 seconds and does not buy anything. Exit 2 means refused;
exit 3 means polling timed out. It does not turn a blocked hosted eval into
a local success. The MCP server initialized and exposed the read-only add
tool successfully, but that alone is not a completed evaluation.
